title: Local Noetherian comparison models for proper-support tensor data
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be of finite presentation [def-pc-morphism-conventions], $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and $G^\bullet$ a bounded complex of finitely presented modules, termwise flat over S, with each term supported properly over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Set $K=Rf_*(E\otimes^L G^\bullet)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For each $x\in S$ there are an open neighbourhood $U$, schemes $X_i,S_i$ with $S_i$ Noetherian, a finite-presentation morphism $f_i:X_i\to S_i$, a perfect $E_i$, a bounded finitely presented termwise $S_i$-flat complex $G_i^\bullet$ with proper term supports, and a morphism $g:U\to S_i$, together with an isomorphism $L\iota_U^*K\cong Lg^*Rf_{i,*}(E_i\otimes^L G_i^\bullet)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. No assertion about perfectness of either direct image is part of this statement.

source.place: Tag 0A1H, lemma-base-change-tensor-perfect, affine reduction and Noetherian approximation paragraph

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood U of x. Restrict the morphism and tensor data to U and its inverse image. Open base change identifies the derived restriction of K with the direct image of restricted data. Open restriction preserves all input properties, including proper support.

Write the ring of U as the filtered colimit of its finitely generated Z-subalgebras. These rings are Noetherian. Spread the finitely presented scheme to a stage and invoke noetherian_approximation_data to obtain Xi, fi, Ei, Gi, with all their properties and pullback identifications.

Let Si be Spec of that stage and g the map from U. Identify the descended cartesian square with the pullback square. Apply ordinary relatively flat tensor base change to fi and g. Compose its isomorphism with the descended E and complex identifications and the first open-base-change comparison. The result is the required isomorphism, without using any direct-image perfectness assertion.

theorem properSupport_local_noetherian_model
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : Scheme.IsPerfect X E)
    (G : CochainComplex X.Modules ℤ)
    (hGb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G.X n))
    [∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFinitePresentation]
    (hGflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (G.X n).IsFlatOver f)
    (hGproper : ∀ n : ℤ, Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver f (G.X n)) (x : S) :
    ∃ U : S.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (Xi Si : Scheme.{u}) (fi : Xi ⟶ Si),
        IsNoetherian Si ∧ LocallyOfFinitePresentation fi ∧
        QuasiCompact fi ∧ QuasiSeparated fi ∧
        ∃ (hfi : LocallyOfFiniteType fi) (Ei : schemeDerivedCategory Xi),
          Scheme.IsPerfect Xi Ei ∧
          ∃ Gi : CochainComplex Xi.Modules ℤ,
            (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (Gi.X n)) ∧
            (∀ n : ℤ, (Gi.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧
            (∀ n : ℤ, (Gi.X n).IsFlatOver fi) ∧
            (∀ n : ℤ, @Scheme.Modules.HasSupportProperOver _ _ fi hfi (Gi.X n)) ∧
            ∃ g : U.toScheme ⟶ Si,
              Nonempty ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj
                  ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)) ≅
                (derivedPullback g).obj
                  ((schemeDerivedDirectImage fi).obj (Ei ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj Gi)))
